description:
Vital Recorder is open with case 0003.vital loaded, showing a ~1-hour intraoperative recording from a noncardiac surgery (VitalDB open dataset, Seoul National University Hospital). This case includes ventilator and anesthetic agent monitoring: ECG leads (ECG_II, ECG_V5), pulse oximetry (PLETH), lung compliance (COMPLIANCE), inspired/expired sevoflurane concentrations (INSP_SEVO, EXP_SEVO), and airway pressures (PAMB_MBAR, MAWP_MBAR, PPLAT_MBAR). The events panel shows Case started, Surgery started, Surgery finished, and Case finished.

As an anesthesiologist reviewing this case for quality assurance, you need to:
1. Export the recording data to CSV format, saved as C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\case_0003_review.csv
2. Switch the display to Monitor mode (which shows numeric vital signs values in large-format panels, similar to a bedside patient monitor) and capture a screenshot of this monitor view. Save the screenshot as C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\monitor_view_0003.png

The CSV export should contain the vital signs data including the anesthetic monitoring tracks. The screenshot should show the Monitor mode display with numeric values visible.

Login: Desktop user (no login required).
